what_to_detect: A spell cast for its cleave cost resolves. Forge scripts cleave as a second spell line with PrecostDesc$ Cleave whose text has the bracketed words removed, not as a keyword line (so no gen-3 cast_with marks it), and the resolution acts through that line; no event is common to cleave spells (they destroy, draw, deal damage, counter, take turns), so outcome_event has no event to name, and resolution_outcome reads no script parameter.
near_miss: A spell of a card with cleave resolving through its ordinary line, cast for its mana cost.
